basis: Source inspection of materialized and streamed Gradient contractions shows that the identical binary64 centred coefficient difference is recomputed for each Cartesian axis. V15 is the current measured best native base (52.748245 CPU seconds per-step envelope); this is an orthogonal V15-plus-scratch experiment, regardless of the still-running V17 integer-index result.
change: Within each individual field Gradient call, compute state[offset+id[j]]-centre*constant[j] once into at most 128 binary64 stack entries. Preserve centre, every original double difference, all three derivative rows, chronological per-axis long-double products and sums, and final casts. Streamed two-field gradients use separate fresh scratch per actual field. No reduction-order change, skipped axis, persistent field state, coefficient cache or constitutive validity reuse.
fallback: Off and V1-V17 retain their original arithmetic; rows wider than 128 use the original contraction. Manually assembled functionals default to the original contraction. Every field/patch flag must agree at construction. V18 inherits V15, excludes V16 sampler, V17 index table, V13 gradient memo and V12 coverage hash; all prior experimental code/receipts remain.
qualification: Set NEKTAR_RANS_VERIFY_GRADIENT_SCRATCH=1 and all earlier cold verifiers for the four small operators, 44 dependency/geometry queries, Off updates, 4 versus 2+2 genuine continuation, cache quotas 1024, rejected-step full rollback, unknown and foreign V17/Off history negatives. The scratch verifier re-evaluates the original unmodified contraction and compares all three binary64 outputs including signed zero. Streamed gradient verifier forces original materialized-row arithmetic. Then selected timing-off 0/1/2 and diagnostic one-step controls against CT14; a local speedup alone cannot pass G1-G6.
bounds: One-call 128-double scratch (one KiB), no heap cache or persistent state; all geometry/side/field/offset checks, physical inventories, FE/quadrature identities, solver residual/refinement and numerical/physical thresholds unchanged. One family/rank, six numerical libraries single-thread, compiler jobs two, project16/aggregate72; original CT16 24000 CPU seconds/28800 elapsed wall seconds/16GiB new live/16GiB process AS and publication reserve.
interpretation: Measured hypothesis only. V15 remains plainly insufficient for production; do not spend a full pair/retention qualification merely to obtain another partial PASS. Retain all costs and failures, no T>.002. The actual 32-step production restart model is conditional and unvalidated; no selected native retention has yet been qualified.
